dod_intent_evidence: Air Force SBIR Phase II ($749,592) for the Multi-Purpose Expeditionary Platform, developed against an explicit AFWERX Rapid Sustainment need (SBIR/STTR section).
score_evidence: "This advanced platform will be tested and demonstrated to verify its performance" -> lab_language_intensity (demo-to-verify framing)
"develop a testing protocol acceptable to our AF partners" at a university proving ground -> deployment_awareness_absence (validation stops at a controlled RELLIS test range, not the field)
no jobs data in pack -> hiring_profile_skew set to 10
SBIR PhII awarded 2022 with a ~8-person team and Inc5000 growth chasing -> stage_pressure (period-of-performance clock long since running)

blind_spots.blind_spot: Real-time sensor telemetry to the operator assumes a live radio link
blind_spots.operator_reality: An E-5 driving the MPEP at an austere OCONUS site has intermittent/low-bandwidth comms; LiDAR + visual + thermal + IMU streamed 'to the operator so they can visualize the environment' collapses to a stale feed the moment the link degrades
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Tested at a university proving ground with clean spectrum, so the contested-comms failure mode never surfaces
blind_spots.evidence_quote: This sensor information will also be transmitted to the operator so that they can visualize the environment

blind_spots.blind_spot: GPS 'teach and repeat' has no stated GPS-denied fallback
blind_spots.operator_reality: Expeditionary and contested environments routinely jam or spoof GPS; a follow-the-recorded-path autonomy that depends on GPS strands the platform exactly where sustainment robotics are needed most
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Objective framed around reducing operator workload, not around adversary electronic warfare
blind_spots.evidence_quote: We will develop GPS-based “teach and repeat” such that the vehicle can follow a path that has been previously driven

blind_spots.blind_spot: Sustainment/spares logistics for a hydraulic quick-attach platform is unaddressed
blind_spots.operator_reality: A ruggedized machine with hydraulic connectors and swappable attachments needs a spares tail, field maintainers, and battery/power logistics at the site — the very 'logistics tail' the product claims to shrink becomes its own
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Phase II scope is autonomy features and a touchscreen controller, not fielded sustainment doctrine
blind_spots.evidence_quote: The quick attach hydraulic connectors allow the MPEP to provide additional functionalities

opener_hook: Your MPEP Phase II validation plan ends at the RELLIS proving ground with 'a testing protocol acceptable to our AF partners' — a clean-spectrum range, not a GPS-denied austere site where the teach-and-repeat and live sensor feed actually have to hold.
what_they_do: Public-safety/defense tech-development firm building an unmanned Multi-Purpose Expeditionary Platform for Air Force rapid sustainment, alongside a scale-up manufacturing services division.
